name: Hagino Tooru
source: Ayano's twin brother. He becomes interested in the new girl Ikumi and tries hard to get on her good side. Ayano is overly protective of the new girl in class however and makes it difficult for him to get close. He often ends up saying or doing stupid things as a result.
